paper.title: Leave No Observation Behind: Real-time Correction for VLA Action Chunks

official_release_inconsistencies.issue: The paper appendix specifies 200000 correction-head updates, while the frozen README and uploaded train_config specify 400000.
official_release_inconsistencies.consequence: An exact retraining budget is not uniquely recoverable from primary sources.
official_release_inconsistencies.resolution_for_correction: Do not retrain; use the immutable uploaded checkpoint.

official_release_inconsistencies.issue: The paper specifies a 6-layer transformer with base latent/language input, while the pre-redaction evaluator names a public 10-layer checkpoint without vlm_hidden.
official_release_inconsistencies.consequence: The named default artifact is not a structural match to the paper method.
official_release_inconsistencies.resolution_for_correction: Use the author's public add_vlm_context checkpoint, the only inspected public artifact matching the paper's six-layer and base-latent structure; retain a local-port label.

official_release_inconsistencies.issue: The paper states MLP hidden size 512, while the frozen released implementation uses dim_model*2=1024 in the residual head.
official_release_inconsistencies.consequence: The public checkpoint follows released code rather than every prose detail.
official_release_inconsistencies.resolution_for_correction: Load the immutable checkpoint with its released graph; never call the run an exact official reproduction.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Author evaluation uses k1000dai/smolvla_libero_spatial_scratch, trained from scratch on LIBERO Spatial.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 used pepijn223/smolvla_libero, trained on the 40-task lerobot/libero corpus.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: Different checkpoint, training corpus, state/config lineage, and latent width (official 960 versus captured local 576).
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Material compatibility and distribution shift for both base chunks and correction-head inputs; effect direction is not assumed.
audit_rows.required_rerun_scope: matched corrected Base and Prior on new identities

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Spatial-only scratch SmolVLA, batch 64, 100000 steps, frozen vision encoder and expert-only training in uploaded config.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: General LIBERO checkpoint, batch 32, 25000 steps, nonfrozen vision encoder and non-expert-only training in local config.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: The v1 base is not the base used to create the official residual dataset/checkpoint.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Breaks the learned relationship between stale base actions/latents and the official correction head.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Top and wrist RGB at 256x256.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: Top and wrist RGB tensors at 256x256 after the local preprocessing map.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Official evaluator rotates both agent and wrist images 180 degrees before policy and correction-head inference.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: Installed LeRobot 0.4.4 LiberoEnv returns raw camera arrays and preprocess_observation only changes layout/range; v1 applies no 180-degree rotation.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: Both live RGB streams have the wrong orientation relative to the official training/evaluation path.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Material observation distribution shift for the base and residual visual encoders; effect direction is not assumed.
audit_rows.required_rerun_scope: matched corrected Base and Prior on new identities

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: 8D state and 7D relative action.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: Live input audit records 8D state and 7D relative action.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Paper uses language embedded by SmolVLM and a base-policy latent; paper-aligned public checkpoint expects vlm_hidden[960].
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 captures a 576D prefix token from a different base and separately uses the released SHA1 scalar task token.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: Wrong base-latent dimension and source checkpoint; the paired official checkpoint cannot be meaningfully driven by the v1 latent.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Material incompatibility in a core correction-head feature.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Uploaded correction checkpoint stores normalization derived from its full 432-episode Spatial residual dataset and paired base chunks.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 constructs normalization from the local 40-task LeRobot dataset and locally generated chunks.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: Different state/action/image statistics and base-action distribution.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Changes normalized residual scale and denormalized executed actions.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: d is the number of control steps between observation receipt and availability of its chunk; d <= e <= H-d.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 injects d=10 with e=40 and H=50 by retaining ten actions from the previous chunk.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: First chunk executes [0,e) and retains [e,e+d); later chunks execute d retained old actions plus new [d,e), retaining new [e,e+d).
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 implements the same queue slices and raises on pending underflow.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified; no off-by-one defect proven.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: The client retains already generated prior-chunk actions while one new inference is pending; it does not query future expert actions.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 uses only already generated base chunks and no expert/future actions at live inference.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Reset, set the selected official init state, then execute ten [0,0,0,0,0,0,-1] no-op steps.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: The local runner sets init_state_id before env.reset; installed LiberoEnv selects that official state and internally runs the same ten no-op steps.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Correction head receives the latest observation and runs once per executed control action.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 re-preprocesses the current live observation and calls the prior for every action.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified apart from the image-orientation defect.

audit_rows.item: selected base action and full chunk
audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Selected stale base action and the full source 50x7 chunk are supplied.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 supplies the selected action and its unchanged source 50x7 chunk.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Released training/eval code uses sin/cos(2*pi*k/(H-1)); paper prose writes H.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 follows released code and uses H-1.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None against released implementation; paper/code discrepancy is documented.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Expert demonstration action minus the matched stale base action in normalized action space.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 uses the same target construction with expert action only during training.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Normalize base action, predict normalized additive residual, add, then unnormalize to environment action space.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 uses the same ordering.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Mean squared normalized residual loss; released evaluator applies no extra residual clamp, action clip, or gripper discretization.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 uses MSE and applies no extra clamp, clip, or gripper discretization.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: All 432 LIBERO Spatial episodes, 52970 frames, and 10 tasks.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 uses 40 predeclared episodes (four per task) and materializes 2438 cached training rows.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: Approximately one tenth of episodes plus anchor-stride subsampling replaces the full training distribution.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Substantially weaker task/phase/reset coverage; effect size is not inferred from v1 outcomes.
audit_rows.required_rerun_scope: use immutable official checkpoint; no local retraining

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Each frame is a possible anchor and an offset is sampled online uniformly from the valid range 0..min(49, episode remainder).
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 uses anchor stride 8 and four deterministic offsets per anchor.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Reduces temporal coverage and changes supervision weighting.
audit_rows.required_rerun_scope: use immutable official checkpoint; no local retraining

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Batch 64, AdamW lr=1e-5, weight decay=1e-5, grad clip=10; paper says 200000 steps and uploaded config says 400000.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: Microbatch 4 and 40000 updates with the same optimizer scalars.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: Local batch and update count are much smaller; primary sources disagree on the exact official step count.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Material optimization-path difference; direction is not assumed.
audit_rows.required_rerun_scope: use immutable official checkpoint; no hyperparameter choice

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: The paper-aligned public checkpoint config has freeze_vision_backbone=false.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 explicitly freezes the ResNet-18 encoder and verifies it unchanged.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: A large trainable component of the uploaded path is frozen in v1 (21,281,287 trainable of 32,448,199 total).
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Changes the learned visual representation and trainable capacity.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: The author account publicly hosts immutable residual checkpoints, including a six-layer add_vlm_context checkpoint and its full dataset.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 protocol states that no official A2C2 correction-head checkpoint is available and trains a local checkpoint.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: The asset-availability premise was false at audit time; the public artifact predates the local v1 run.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: v1 did not evaluate the strongest executable author-supplied mechanism path.
audit_rows.required_rerun_scope: download, hash-verify, disk-reload, and evaluate the pinned public pair

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Correction is an additive per-step plug-in; disabling it leaves the base queue/actions unchanged.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 maintains separate Base and Prior arms with identical base noise schedule and queue.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: All 10 LIBERO Spatial tasks; screening uses 10 rollouts/task and reported selected conditions use 50 rollouts/task.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: Three preregistered tasks and five official init states per task.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: Higher uncertainty and less task coverage; it does not itself explain the sign of v1.
audit_rows.required_rerun_scope: preserve local 3x5 decision design but use new identities; do not reinterpret as paper-scale reproduction

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Selected reported conditions include e=10,d=0 and e=40,d=10 with H=50 and max 220 simulator steps for Spatial.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 uses those conditions and H=50/max 220.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: None identified.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Official LIBERO done/check_success; evaluator seeds torch/numpy with 7 and uses official init states.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 uses official check_success/is_success and official init states with a frozen deterministic per-chunk noise seed schedule.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: Noise scheduling differs from the script's global RNG stream, but is paired across Base/Prior and not an A2C2 mechanism defect.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: May change individual trajectories but not comparator fairness; use a frozen paired schedule in the corrected panel.

audit_rows.official_published_behavior: Paper reports 89.2% versus 81.8% at e=10,d=0 and 84.2% versus 64.4% at e=40,d=10 in the 50-rollout/task table; a separate paragraph rounds the latter Base to 67%.
audit_rows.current_local_behavior: v1 local panel reports 10/15 Base standard, 4/15 delayed Base, and 3/15 local Prior.
audit_rows.exact_mismatch: Local results and scale differ; this row is descriptive and was not used to infer the fidelity defects.
audit_rows.expected_scientific_effect: No causal inference; motivates testing the author-supplied path without tuning old outcomes.

objective_fidelity_defects.unique_correction: rotate both live RGB observations 180 degrees exactly as the frozen official evaluator before both base and prior preprocessing

next_authorized_action: Freeze focused tests and the corrected official-pair protocol, then perform a bounded compatibility/resource preflight on new development identities before one corrected matched panel.
